weaponFits.note: Glowing Pumpkin Basket: Nexon lists 1H/2H swords, axes and blunt weapons, daggers, spears, polearms, wands, staves, bows, crossbows and claws. GMS 270 ships one frame book (tagged 1H Sword) whose generic stand/walk/swing/stab/shoot actions cover every stance, so the other types share that base art.

hide.note: Race Queen Uniform (Mystery Fashion Crate 2.50%): MCW serves stale retail BLUE art (worn render verified vs red/white Nexon set 2026-10-21); GMS 270 has nothing. True Classic art in no dataset yet. Drop when a source grows the red/white art.

Glowing Pumpkin Basket (Halloween Mystery Fashion Crate 2.00%): GMS 270 ships only per-weapon-type frames (no frameBooks) and MCW CBT2 serves a different item (Super Scrubber) under this id; nothing bakeable yet. Drop when a source ships avatar frames for it.
